commits.subject: fix: fail closed on corrupt reconciliation evidence

release_notes.text: Added review-gated post-trade Combo reconciliation that derives deterministic Put/Call lot pairings from authoritative ledger facts and writes canonical Combo identities only after exact operator confirmation.

Hardened lifecycle and position-fact reconciliation with account-coherent frozen evidence, exact Combo membership validation, and per-case due-run isolation so malformed or ambiguous holdings fail closed without interrupting unrelated cases.
Made read-only trade-intake reconciliation reject corrupt persisted JSON instead of treating it as an empty state, preserving fail-closed production quality signals.

no_release_note.reason: Ancestry-only integration of the already released v1.7.8 hotfix with the reviewed mainline changes; no independent runtime behavior.
